title: Entertainment
desc: Akhil, an underdog and a failure, comes to know that his real father is a rich diamond merchant who has just passed away. When he goes to retrieve his wealth, he learns that a dog has inherited it.

title: Sanam Teri Kasam
desc: Sunny travels to Shimla for a job opportunity, unaware that the employer is his estranged father, Manoharlal. However, tensions rise when a villain, greedy for his father's wealth, hatches a plot.

title: Surya The Soldier
desc: When a soldier lands in trouble due to his anger issues, he begins seeing a psychologist in hopes of one day returning to duty.

title: Judaai
desc: Shashikant and Gauri get married in honour of his late father's will. But, marital problems soon arise when Gauri suspects him of having an affair, leading to a chain of misunderstandings.
